pictures.name: TS1-Medina-Room
pictures.prompt: A simple room in old Medina, long ago: mud-brick walls, a roof of palm fronds, a woven mat with two cushions set side by side, morning sunlight streaming through the open doorway in a bright beam. Calm and homely. No people or human figures of any kind. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
